basic_info.description: Experience the best of city living in this spacious and contemporary 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo! With approximately 743 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space, enjoy a bright and open floor plan featuring generous living and dining areas, a well-appointed kitchen, and a large bedroom with ample closet space. Designated bonus office space and in-unit laundry offer ultimate convenience.This home provides comfort, convenience, and an unbeatable location in the heart of Ingleside Heights!
